point_3_unseen_framework_generalization.interpretation: The semantic framework model g(e(x), e(P)) achieves R2 = 0.3650 (r = 0.6043) on unseen articles within seen frameworks. Crucially, under zero-shot framework generalization to frameworks never seen during training (Regime 3), the model achieves pooled R2 = -0.1070 (r = 0.1600, macro R2 = -0.7758). Under completely crossed unseen-article x unseen-framework holdout (Regime 4), it achieves pooled R2 = -0.1085 (r = 0.1497). This decisively demonstrates that framework dependence is driven by semantic interactions between article text and hypothesis meaning, rather than static memorization of 14 one-hot offsets.

point_4_interaction_permutation_test.interpretation: Under 1,000 article-level framework permutations preserving repeated-measures marginal distributions, the relational interaction gain Delta R2 = +0.2087 decisively exceeds chance (null mean = -0.1328, 95% null CI: [-0.1855, -0.0838], p = 0.0010 <= 0.0010). Genuine article x framework interaction is statistically indispensable.
